# TWINGS — service context

Updated: 2026-10-24
Canonical public website: https://twings.app
Operator: YAGI WORKSHOP Inc. / 야기워크숍 주식회사
Public contact: hello@yagiworkshop.xyz
Languages: Korean (/ko) and English (/en).

## What the service is

TWINGS presents studio-reviewed AI video and image templates. A template page shows an example, the relevant format, and its listed price. The intended personal creation flow uses the account holder's own photo to make a finished result in the selected format. Users choose a template, not a general-purpose prompt editor.

Public browsing and examples do not require an account. The current pricing and FAQ pages are the source for generation and subscription availability. Do not infer that a published template, a sign-in screen, or a listed price proves public checkout is available. Do not describe subscriptions, free identity-portrait allowances, SNS OAuth integrations, or App Store/Google Play apps as launched merely because they have been discussed or designed.

## Pricing and payment

The pricing page shows the Creator and Premium monthly plans, the video capacity for a selected length, and whether each plan can currently be purchased. Creator and Premium can have different availability: Premium requires its adjustment feature to be ready. Use the current page status rather than inferring availability from this reading aid. Single-template purchase availability and prices are shown on the current template and checkout pages. This document does not invent a minimum price or convert currencies. A template that is not for sale must not be described as a free offer.

See https://twings.app/ko/pricing and https://twings.app/en/pricing.

## Photos, identity, data protection and zero-training guarantee

Use your own face and comply with the service's identity and likeness rules. Uploading a photo does not authorize using somebody else's likeness, impersonation, or rights violations. Account-bound identity assets and additional verification may apply. AI output may differ from an example and may contain errors; an example is not a promise of an identical result.

Under TWINGS's enterprise data protection agreements (DPA), uploaded face photos, creator likenesses, and brand assets are processed using TLS 1.2+ in-transit and AES-256 at-rest encryption solely to generate the requested outputs, and are contractually prohibited from being used to train, fine-tune, or improve external AI models.

Privacy, retention, deletion, permitted use, and withdrawal rights are governed by the current policy pages. Reports about unauthorized likeness use and requests about personal data can be sent to the public contact address. Do not invent broader consent, a data-retention period, or a commercial license from this summary.

## Refunds

The current refund policy distinguishes one-time purchases from any approved monthly subscription terms. For monthly plans, the current account and policy pages state cancellation, renewal and refund conditions. A failed monthly video restores its reserved video capacity; this is different from refunding a whole subscription payment. Read the linked policy for exact conditions, deadlines and procedures; this summary does not replace it.

## Brand campaigns and creators

TWINGS operates brand creator campaigns through its studio. A brand briefs the studio on the campaign, desired content and budget. The studio manages production and creator coordination. Creators apply to suitable campaigns and follow the selected campaign's posting, disclosure and submission requirements. Selection is not guaranteed. A submitted post link is evidence for review; it does not by itself prove verified reach or payout eligibility.

The brand service combines influencer likeness licensing, high-quality AI video format production completed from a single selfie (with zero live shoots), and scalable distribution on actual creator channels. One format can be used by multiple creators. Standalone AI brand ad and campaign film production is also offered through YAGI (whose production collaborations include Galeries Lafayette in France, The Hyundai in Korea, and leading fashion and beauty brands), without requiring a creator campaign. Content reuse depends on agreed creator rights; campaign costs and timelines depend on scope.

Partnered creator pools of 5,000+ influencers in Korea and Japan support simultaneous campaigns in both markets with no additional sourcing commission, with messages and creators selected for each market. The brand FAQ explains likeness consent, provider moderation, human post review, advertising disclosures, and personal-data handling. This describes operating procedures, not a security certification or a guarantee of compliance in every jurisdiction.

Creator compensation and studio margin are not a public brand price list. Do not infer an individual creator's payment from a brand campaign budget. Campaign availability and participation conditions must be checked on the current campaign page. Do not describe follower counts, impressions, attributed conversions, or audience data as verified unless the report identifies the evidence and measurement source.

Brand services and the public enquiry form: https://twings.app/ko/brands and https://twings.app/en/brands. Initial enquiries do not require an account. The brand workspace on brand.twings.app is for ongoing work and requires authorization.

### Public Morphic case studies

Customer stories are grouped by client at https://twings.app/ko/brands/stories and https://twings.app/en/brands/stories. The permanent Morphic story is https://twings.app/ko/brands/stories/morphic and https://twings.app/en/brands/stories/morphic. Campaign-specific evidence remains separate within that customer story.

TWINGS publicly identifies Morphic for two approved case summaries. In the August 2026 1990s interview-format campaign, 9 campaign films reached 2M+ total views, and the format produced 300+ pieces of derivative organic content across Instagram and other channels. The film count of 9 is exact; 2M+ and 300+ are campaign-level lower bounds, not an individual creator result or an attributed conversion rate.

After the first campaign, work continued in September 2026 through a Korea-and-Japan follow-up campaign. TWINGS handled format production, creator recruitment, post review and result organization. This continuation is evidence of a follow-up engagement; it must not be rewritten as a consumer conversion claim. The September films shown on the brand page belong to that follow-up and carry the Morphic mark. Morphic's official 1990s street-style interview guide is linked from the public case page as supporting context.

Creator opportunities: https://twings.app/ko/campaigns and https://twings.app/en/campaigns. Creators can inspect briefs before signing in to apply. Choosing Brands or Creators in the public navigation changes the page, not the visitor's account role or permissions. The creator journey continues on the web without requiring an app installation.

## Frequently asked questions

The Korean FAQ at https://twings.app/ko/faq and English FAQ at https://twings.app/en/faq share a catalog with the visible FAQ blocks on the landing, template and campaign pages. They cover use, payment, photos and likeness rights, creator participation and brand commissioning. The current page text, not a cached copy of this file, is the source for those answers.
